nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; written by the constructor and by transferOwnership/claimOwnership.
Address nominated to become the next owner; consumed by claimOwnership.
Global pause flag toggled by the owner and read by requireNotPaused.
Human readable notice string stored when pausing/unpausing all tokens.
Constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
Owner only function that immediately reassigns the owner state variable.
Owner only function that nominates a pendingOwner instead of transferring directly.
pendingOwner only function that finalizes ownership transfer and clears pendingOwner.
Owner only function that sets the global pause flag and notice string.
View function that reverts when allTokensPaused is true, returning pauseNotice.
Caller supplied address used for ownership assignment and all access control checks.
Assignment owner = msg.sender performed unconditionally in the constructor.
Privileged assignment owner = newOwner executed after the onlyOwner check.
Privileged assignment pendingOwner = newOwner executed after the onlyOwner check.
Privileged assignment owner = pendingOwner followed by clearing pendingOwner.
Privileged write of the global pause flag controlled by owner.
Privileged write of the pause notice string controlled by owner.
Caller supplied newOwner argument of Ownable.transferOwnership.
Caller supplied newOwner argument of Claimable.transferOwnership.
Boolean status argument of GlobalPause.pauseAllTokens.
String notice argument of GlobalPause.pauseAllTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written directly into the owner state variable without any authorization check in the constructor.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferOwnership.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate Claimable.transferOwnership.
onlyPendingOwner compares msg.sender against pendingOwner to gate claimOwnership.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate pauseAllTokens.
Constructor body executes the owner = msg.sender assignment.
Constructor initializes the owner state variable.
Ownable.transferOwnership performs the privileged owner reassignment.
Ownable.transferOwnership reads owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.
The newOwner parameter flows into the owner assignment.
The assignment writes the new value of the owner state variable.
Claimable.transferOwnership writes the pendingOwner nomination.
The newOwner parameter flows into the pendingOwner assignment.
The assignment updates the pendingOwner state variable.
claimOwnership executes the ownership finalization assignment.
claimOwnership reads owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.
claimOwnership reads pendingOwner to finalize the transfer.
claimOwnership sets owner to the previous pendingOwner.
claimOwnership resets pendingOwner to address(0).
pauseAllTokens performs the pause flag write.
pauseAllTokens performs the notice string write.
The _status parameter flows into the allTokensPaused assignment.
The _notice parameter flows into the pauseNotice assignment.
The assignment updates the allTokensPaused state variable.
The assignment updates the pauseNotice state variable.
requireNotPaused reads the allTokensPaused flag for its require check.
requireNotPaused reads pauseNotice as the revert reason.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter only exists to feed the privileged owner assignment in Ownable.transferOwnership.
The newOwner parameter only exists to feed the pendingOwner assignment in Claimable.transferOwnership.
The _status parameter is written straight into the allTokensPaused state variable.
The _notice parameter is written straight into the pauseNotice state variable.
